facts.text: I am asking for a new product description for the product "CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators".
CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators are used during cardiopulmonary bypass to remove excess fluid from the blood.
CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators are used during cardiopulmonary bypass to maintain proper hematocrit and protein concentration.
CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators enable reinfusion of blood remaining in the circuit after bypass.
The membrane of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators is composed of polysulfone.
The membrane is designed to achieve a high ultrafiltration rate (UFR) for efficient blood concentration in a short time.
The membrane is designed to restrict removal of albumin.
The inlet blood port of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators is designed to ensure smooth blood flow.
The inlet blood port of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators is designed to reduce possible stagnation.
The inlet blood port of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators is designed to prevent thrombus formation.
The filters of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators are intended to have a low priming volume.
The filters are intended to keep the device compact and light.
The filters are intended to require little storage space.
The filters are intended to offer easy disposal.
No-rinse hollow fibers of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators are designed to enable quick set up even during operation.
The entire housing of CAPIOX Hemoconcentrators, including blood ports, is transparent.
The transparent housing is designed for easy visual checking.
Immunoassay Systems are analyzers that use antibodies or antigens to measure the concentration of a molecule for diagnostic purposes using test cartridges.
Immunoassay Systems test and detect using various methods including enzymes, radioactive isotopes, DNA probes, fluorescence, and electrochemilumenescence.
Various test modes are available depending on the device.
Immunoassay Systems include read now and walk away modes.
VITROS 3600 Immunodiagnostic System is an immunoassay system used to analyze assays for quantitative, semi-quantitative, and qualitative measurements.
VITROS 3600 uses MicroWell, Intellicheck, and MicroSensor immunodiagnostic technologies to perform tests.
VITROS 3600 is designed to increase operating efficiency and deliver high quality results in a predictable turnaround time.
VITROS 3600 is standardized with other VITROS systems.
VITROS 3600 is able to change consumables, waste, and reagents while operating.
VITROS 3600 is designed to deliver an uninterrupted workflow.
VITROS 3600 is designed to be easy to use and eco-friendly.
VITROS 4600 is an immunoassay system for the in vitro measurement of various clinical analytes including serum, plasma, urine, and cerebrospinal fluid.
VITROS 4600 consists of a clinical chemistry analyzer, display monitor, controls, reagents, and disposable instrumentation.
VITROS 4600 features VITROS MicroSlide technology.
VITROS MicroSlide technology is intended to minimize operator interventions and maximize ease of use.
VITROS 4600 includes VITROS Intellicheck technology.
VITROS Intellicheck technology is designed to deliver real-time process monitoring and reduce the risk of incorrect result reporting.
The Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer is a bench top analyzer used for fluorescent detection of various pathogens.
The Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer uses an ultraviolet LED source and a sensor to collect data from each test cassette.
Available tests for the Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer include hCG, Influenza A and B, RSV, and Strep A.
The Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer may be used in two different workflow modes.
The walk away mode is designed for use with a single patient sample placed in the Sofia.
In walk away mode, the cassette is developed and scanned before displaying results.
The read now mode is designed for use with several patient samples.
In read now mode, the user manually develops the sample outside the analyzer.
In read now mode, once development is complete, the sample is placed in the Sofia and immediately scanned.
In the Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer, results are displayed within one minute.
The Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer has an integrated printer.
Results from the Sofia Fluorescent Immunoassay Analyzer may be printed, stored on the provided SD card, or sent to a laboratory information system (LIS).
